product_summary: Hot cappuccino in a compact off-white glazed ceramic cup with two thin black rim stripes, small curved black typography and one loop handle on image-right. Preserve the exact cup and coffee; discard the source saucer, hand, sleeve, wall and source lighting for this cup-body grip pose.

identity.beverage: hot cappuccino with a thin natural crema

container.class: compact off-white glazed ceramic handled cup
container.geometry: compact gently tapered ceramic body, thick rounded rim, stable foot and one rounded loop handle; preserve the source cup, not its saucer

branding.placement: no intentional branding or readable text should be added

must_preserve: hot cappuccino identity and thin natural crema
thick rounded rim and right-side rounded loop handle
two thin parallel black stripes following the cylindrical rim curvature
small black CAPPUCCINO typography naturally printed on the curved ceramic wall
complete cup sidewall, handle and base
no invented extra logo, text, straw, ice, garnish or latte art

evidence: open hot coffee surface is visible
thin crema follows the metal rim
no ice, straw or cold-service lid is present

visual_anchor.feature: rounded ceramic rim, two curved black stripes, right loop handle, small curved CAPPUCCINO typography and natural crema
visual_anchor.emphasis_method: preserve cup proportions, glaze and printed design while rebuilding them under the preset's cloudy window and hand-held high-oblique camera

issues: source is a vertical close crop with a tall vessel and a large neutral tabletop field
source light is warmer and more frontal than the approved white close-up scene
evidence: ice, milk and matcha layers remain readable
the glass wall and lower contact area are visible

presentation_correction.intent: reconstruct the exact hot cappuccino and striped ceramic handled cup in the lower left-hand slot without the source saucer

preferred_capture.rotation: rotate the cup in real 3D so the loop handle stays fully visible on image-right; keep the axis nearly neutral with only a 4-6 degree lean toward image 7-8 o'clock

allowed: re-light ceramic and cappuccino under target window light
keep the source cup handle on image-right
adjust scale within the held-slot corridor
forbidden: replace the source ceramic cup with metal, glass or plain unprinted ceramic
retain the source saucer, hand, sleeve or wall
omit or straighten the two curved rim stripes and source cup typography
invent ice, straw, lid, extra logo, text, garnish or latte art
flatten the cup to a top-only view
place the target handle on image-left or hide it behind the hand
tilt the cup axis toward image-right or upper-right
